descriptionChirho: Qal sense: to touch or feel someone/something with the hands, direct physical contact (e.g., Isaac feeling Jacob, Gen 27:12,22).
Piel intensive sense: to grope about or search by feeling, typically describing someone unable to see (blindness, darkness) who searches fumblingly with the hands (e.g., Deut 28:29, Job 5:14, 12:25).

Hifil causative sense: to cause or allow someone to feel/touch something, often as a request to be permitted to touch (e.g., Samson asking to feel the pillars, Judg 16:26; the darkness of Egypt that could be felt, Exod 10:21).
